provenance.latin: Traditional prayers, checked against the Vatican Compendium, Appendix A; capitalization and punctuation normalized. Amen completes the Our Father.
provenance.english: Traditional English for the Sign of the Cross, Our Father, Hail Mary and Glory Be; direct project translations from Latin for the acts and Guardian Angel. Not a reproduction of the Compendium English translation.
provenance.timing: Estimated silent-reading durations, not recorded audio cues.

passages.latin: In nómine Patris, et Fílii, et Spíritus Sancti. Amen.
passages.english: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

passages.latin: Dómine Deus, firma fide credo et confíteor ómnia et síngula quæ sancta Ecclésia Cathólica propónit,
passages.english: Lord God, with firm faith I believe and profess each and every thing that the holy Catholic Church sets forth,

passages.latin: quia tu, Deus, ea ómnia revelásti, qui es ætérna véritas et sapiéntia quæ nec fállere nec falli potest.
passages.english: because you, O God, have revealed them all: you are eternal truth and wisdom, which can neither deceive nor be deceived.

passages.latin: In hac fide vívere et mori státuo. Amen.
passages.english: In this faith I resolve to live and die. Amen.

passages.latin: Dómine Deus, spero per grátiam tuam remissiónem ómnium peccatórum, et post hanc vitam ætérnam felicitátem me esse consecutúrum:
passages.english: Lord God, I hope through your grace to obtain forgiveness of all my sins and eternal happiness after this life,

passages.latin: quia tu promisísti, qui es infiníte potens, fidélis, benígnus, et miséricors.
passages.english: because you have promised it: you are infinitely powerful, faithful, kind, and merciful.

passages.latin: In hac spe vívere et mori státuo. Amen.
passages.english: In this hope I resolve to live and die. Amen.

passages.latin: Dómine Deus, amo te super ómnia et próximum meum propter te,
passages.english: Lord God, I love you above all things and my neighbor for your sake,

passages.latin: quia tu es summum, infinítum, et perfectíssimum bonum, omni dilectióne dignum.
passages.english: because you are the highest, infinite, and most perfect good, worthy of all love.

passages.latin: In hac caritáte vívere et mori státuo. Amen.
passages.english: In this love I resolve to live and die. Amen.

passages.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis: sanctificétur nomen tuum;
passages.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name;

passages.latin: advéniat regnum tuum; fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo, et in terra.
passages.english: thy kingdom come; thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

passages.latin: Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie,
passages.english: Give us this day our daily bread,

passages.latin: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris.
passages.english: and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

passages.latin: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem; sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
passages.english: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

passages.latin: Ave, María, grátia plena, Dóminus tecum.
passages.english: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.

passages.latin: Benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
passages.english: Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

passages.latin: Sancta María, Mater Dei, ora pro nobis peccatóribus, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.
passages.english: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

passages.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
passages.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.

passages.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc et semper, et in sæcula sæculórum. Amen.
passages.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

passages.latin: Ángele Dei, qui custos es mei, me, tibi commíssum pietáte supérna, illúmina, custódi, rege et gubérna. Amen.
passages.english: Angel of God, my guardian, enlighten, guard, rule, and guide me, entrusted to you by heavenly goodness. Amen.

passages.latin: In nómine Patris, et Fílii, et Spíritus Sancti. Amen.
passages.english: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
